statement: Summable (fun k : ℤ => KdVPlan.weight (-KdVPlan.pstar) k * (k : ℝ)^2) ∧ ∀ k : ℤ, k ≠ 0 → KdVPlan.weight (-KdVPlan.pstar) k ≤ (k : ℝ)⁻¹^2
proof:
constructor
· apply Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun k => mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _) (sq_nonneg _)) _ (Real.summable_abs_int_rpow (b := 9/7) (by norm_num))
  intro k
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · simp [hk, KdVPlan.weight]
  have hkR : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have habs : 0 < |(k : ℝ)| := abs_pos.mpr hkR
  have h : KdVPlan.weight (-KdVPlan.pstar) k ≤ ((k : ℝ)^2) ^ (-KdVPlan.pstar) :=
   Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hkR) (by linarith) (by norm_num [KdVPlan.pstar])
  calc
   KdVPlan.weight (-KdVPlan.pstar) k * (k : ℝ)^2 ≤ ((k : ℝ)^2) ^ (-KdVPlan.pstar) * (k : ℝ)^2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (sq_nonneg _)
   _ = |(k : ℝ)| ^ (-(9/7 : ℝ)) := by
    rw [← sq_abs (k : ℝ), ← Real.rpow_two |(k : ℝ)|, ← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt habs), ← Real.rpow_add habs]
    norm_num [KdVPlan.pstar]
· intro k hk
  have hkR : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hk
  calc
   KdVPlan.weight (-KdVPlan.pstar) k ≤ (1+(k : ℝ)^2) ^ (-1 : ℝ) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (k : ℝ)]) (by norm_num [KdVPlan.pstar])
   _ ≤ ((k : ℝ)^2) ^ (-1 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hkR) (by linarith) (by norm_num)
   _ = (k : ℝ)⁻¹^2 := by rw [Real.rpow_neg_one, inv_pow]
